overall_reason: The header's dropdowns open designed menus, the full-screen menu marks 'Home' as the current page and closed after Escape, the hero carousel has a pause button and the stylesheet declares every state family; the gap is the 'Research' dropdown, which stayed open after Escape.

score.reason: T-WHERE-AM-I, T-PHONE-NAV, T-STATE-MATRIX (declared) and T-INTERRUPT pass; T-OVERLAY-CHECK fails on the 'Research' dropdown that did not close after Escape (CMP-013).

visitor_mode: Read (inferred: a company home page that routes visitors to news, research, policy and products, with announcement cards and a 'Try Claude' menu)

findings.title: Overlays are the last answer and behave as overlays
findings.where: header menu trigger 'Research' (and its 'Overview ... Societal Impacts' menu), 1440, motion/t3-normal-600.png
findings.evidence: The capture opened the 'Research' dropdown (overlays.triggers t3, kind menu), which shows nine links in a popover under the pill. After the run the capture pressed Escape and moved the pointer away, and the row records closed_after_escape: false.
findings.before: The Research menu stays open after Escape and after the pointer leaves.
findings.after: The menu closes on Escape with focus back on the 'Research' pill, and closes on pointer leave after a 200 to 300 ms delay (CMP-158).
findings.why: A menu that ignores Escape covers the headline and traps keyboard visitors who opened it by mistake.
findings.root: the header dropdown component used for Research, Policy, Commitments, Company and Try Claude

findings.title: Overlays are the last answer and behave as overlays
findings.where: button '···' ('Related to Introducing Claude Opus 5.5' and four more) on the announcement cards, 1440, tiles/1440-01.png y 325, motion/t1-normal-600.png
findings.evidence: Each announcement card starts with an 18 px tall '···' pill whose accessible name is 'Related to ...'. The capture's click opened a role=dialog named 'Related articles' that holds a short list of links (overlays.triggers t1).
findings.before: A list of related links opens as a dialog from an unlabelled '···' pill.
findings.after: A 'Related' text button that opens a popover or menu, or the related links listed under the card's own links.
findings.why: A dialog for a few links is heavier than the job, and '···' gives no hint of what it opens.

strengths: The full-screen menu (button 'Open menu') dims the page, has a close button, marks 'Home' as the current page in white against grey items, and the capture found it closed after Escape (motion/t0-normal-600.png).
At 375 the header keeps 'Try Claude', search and a named 'Open menu' button, so every destination stays reachable.
The hero carousel has a 'Pause video' button (tiles/1440-01.png, right edge).

The stylesheet declares hover (263, 48 inside a hover media query), focus-visible (109), disabled (27), invalid (6), selected (20) and busy (8) rules, and the focus walk starts on 'Skip to main content'.
The announcement cards use one layout: two labelled link rows ('Model Details', 'System Card') and one 'Read announcement' button each.
not_investigated: Visitor mode inferred from the page; there is no 00-contract.md.

Five images were blocked in the capture (manifest.network), so the menu still shows alt text in place of thumbnails; that is capture context, not a design choice. The cookie banner was dismissed by capture prep ('Reject all cookies'), so T-INTERRUPT does not judge it.
Search: the header search is a labelled custom combobox with the placeholder 'Enter search...'; its results, its no-results state and its error state were not reached by the capture.
What the phone menu holds at 375: the capture opens triggers at 1440 only (the 1440 full-screen menu is the same component).
T-ERROR-PATH: no action on the page sends a request, so no failure run was possible. T-TABLE-READ skipped: no table.
Transition timing of the dropdowns and the pause button (MOT-002) is lens-motion's; target sizes in the phone header are the sweep's (A11-004).
